response.courseDescription: 403 Air Quality Management Air pollution from the perspective of an environmental manager; regulatory framework, management strategies, monitoring, modeling tools, and control technologies. Credit not granted for both CE 403 and CE 503. Cooperative: Open to UI degree-seeking students.
response.coursePrerequisites: CE 341 or CHE 201; admitted to the major in Bioengineering, Chemical Engr, Civil Engr, Computer Engr, Computer Sci, Electrical Engr, Materials Science and Engr, Mechanical Engr, or Software Engr.
